name: Cassano Magnago (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cassano Magnago (letters C and M on white with a red cross, crowned, within olive and oak branches).
history: Municipal flag of Cassano Magnago, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 14 April 1929.
